note: Explicit decisions for reading thread_templates.json. An empty list means the catalog tag has no engine place kind yet, so it is not used. Pay is spoken only: nothing pays out until a job can be finished. The catalog's offer windows of 2 to 14 hours are scaled so a town does not empty during one walk; tune offer_hours_scale by playing.

background_labels.note: Catalog labels to saved character backgrounds. Not used yet: a background hook only applies once an offer exists (roadmap step 4), and then only when the player shows it.

names.note: Which name_pools.json template fits which place kind. A kind not listed keeps 'person name + word'. Inn templates ending in Konağı read as an estate, Misafirhanesi and Konukevi are not found by the word han, and a door or a sleep word in a name would be read as the deed, so those are left out. place_name_avoid are folded word starts no generated name may contain.

openings.note: How opening_lines.json is read. scene_tags and place_tags turn a location into a catalog tag. Only slots in bound_slots can be filled, with the place's saved name: a city has no saved street name, so a line needing one is left out, never guessed. clear_sky_only lines speak of direct sun or last light and are left out in any other weather. Each line's other details are ambience the narrator voices; nothing in them becomes a saved object.
